The life sciences industry tools provider sees FY 2027 revenue of $8B-$8.15B (consensus $7.99B) and non-GAAP EPS of $6.73 to $6.86 (consensus $6.72).
In FY26 Q4, non-GAAP EPS of $1.86 compares to $1.59 in the year-ago period.

Agilent was helped in the quarter by a non-GAAP operating margin of 30%, helped by a 120-basis-point benefit from tariff refunds. Revenue in its two largest divisions, Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets Group and the Agilent CrossLab Group, grew year over year by 12% and 6%, respectively, to $843M and $799M.
The company ended the quarter (Oct. 31) with cash and cash equivalents of ~$1.85B compared to ~$1.8B on Oct. 31, 2025.

title: Agilent jumps on double quarterly beats, guidance
